metadata.summary: The customer, Gaurav, ordered a blueberry bagel sandwich from Manhattan Bagel.

messages.text: Hello Gaurav, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
I like to order blueberry bagel, sandwich.
I found a Single Bagel that can be used to make a blueberry bagel sandwich for one dollar and forty-nine cents. What type of bagel would you like? We have plain, everything, or blueberry.
